reason: I already check several boards each week, and I don't want to spend my job-search time setting up a database and API keys. It could help me track applications, but I would first need to know that it runs easily on my laptop and covers the sources I use.
objection: I would have to host it and configure provider keys before I know whether it will find useful roles.
would_change_my_mind: A short, no-credential demo on my laptop that shows the source coverage and lets me track one real application.
